div.head: II Cn 13
div.ab: ⁊ se ðe utlages weorc gewyrce, wealde se cingc þæs friþes.
And se ðe útlages weorc gewyrce, wealde se cyningc þæs friðes.
Et qui opus útlagii fecerit, eius reuocatio sit in misericordia regis (pacis emendatio in solius regis consistat imperio).
Utlaga. Se ðe útlages weorc gewyrce wealde se cyng ðæs friðes.
And se ðe utlages weorc gewyrce, wealde se cingc þæs friþes.
(Friedloser. B) Und wer Friedlosenwerk verübt: [da] verfüge der König über den Frieden [den jener sich wiederkaufe].
(Outlaw. B) And whoever commits a deed that incurs outlawry: let the king decide on his [being restored to the] peace.
Outlawry. If anyone does the deed of an outlaw, the king alone shall have power to grant him security.
And if anyone commits a deed punishable by outlawry, the king [alone] is to have power to grant him peace.
And the king has the power to grant clemency to those who engage in outlawry.
